title: Development and Prospective Validation of a Deep Learning Algorithm for Predicting Need for Mechanical Ventilation.
summary: A deep-learning model predicted whether patients would require mechanical ventilation using clinical time-series data, with evaluation against ventilation records in an external clinical dataset. The study’s “prospective” wording does not make this a prospective frozen-model workflow evaluation; alarm-scoring choices and absence of care-outcome evidence limit interpretation.
